summary: Fixed all three review findings with six new regressions: workflow-only label mutations preserve concurrent ordinary-label changes; native open state overrides stale terminal labels; server-capped pagination runs to exhaustion. Removed runtime SDK imports from shared RPC contracts while retaining exact devDependency and type validation, fixing isolated production-only installation/build. Taskboard check passes 228 tests. Workspace checks passed except two sandbox EPERM process tests; rerun host-monitor check outside sandbox passed, plus dockside check passed. Live installed plugin rebuilt/reloaded; real Gitea completion, external reopen, native Open and restoration passed with ordinary pilot label retained. Upstream target fetched/current; publication remains deferred to pilot feedback.

state.request: Add a Gitea tracker to Taskboard through the installed tea CLI. Support explicitly scoped tea login and owner/repo, list and live issue/comment details, issue creation with labels assignees milestones due date when available, native open/closed and status/* label Kanban transitions, CLI and UI configuration, append-only database upgrades, meaningful tests and live verification. Work in this fresh isolated checkout and user-authorized feat/taskboard-gitea-tea branch. Create a draft PR only in our GitHub fork aotd1/bb-plugins and install a separate local pilot plugin identity. Do not create upstream issues or PRs until seven days of actual pilot use have elapsed.
